reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through our expense app and it works fine. Adding a bot means another sheet to reconcile against what we already have, and I'm not paying to have two systems.
objection: Half the nota from material shops on site are handwritten and faded. If the bot misreads amounts, my bookkeeper ends up checking every row anyway, so what am I paying for?
would_change_my_mind: If I ran the free 40 on our messiest handwritten site receipts and it got almost all of them right, and it could push into Jurnal instead of a separate Google Sheet.
